scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @finband/web" "npm run dev -w @finband/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @finband/shared && npm run build -w @finband/web && npm run build -w @finband/api
scripts.lint: oxlint -c apps/web/.oxlintrc.json apps/web/src && oxlint -c apps/api/.oxlintrc.json apps/api/src apps/api/test
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @finband/shared && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.app.json --noEmit
